decisions_log.decision: The entry count paragraph is inserted between the <h1> and the existing description paragraph, matching 'directly below the page heading'.
decisions_log.rationale: The task specifies the count appears directly below the <h1>; inserting it before the existing description is the most literal interpretation and the most natural visual hierarchy.

decisions_log.decision: Used jest.mock factory returning a static [] then jest.requireMock() to obtain and mutate the shared array reference in each test, rather than jest.resetModules() + dynamic import.
decisions_log.rationale: jest.resetModules() causes a duplicate React instance which breaks useState hooks. Mutating the mock array in-place avoids module reloading while still allowing per-test data control.
